case_chains.position_and_attribution: Firm-level institutional research and Pure Alpha result; no authenticated instrument-level execution ledger. Do not invent long-bond/short-equity/gold weights or personal single-handed causation.
case_chains.outcome_evidence: Fortune reported Pure Alpha gross return of 14% for 2008. This is not a universal net/share-class return.
case_chains.adverse_path_evidence: March 2020 client note recalls a roughly 20% decline in Pure Alpha 18% from its 2008 peak despite the positive calendar year.
competing_explanations: Diversification and execution may contribute beyond the public macro thesis
Gross/net fees and risk class affect the outcome
Positive calendar-year result does not prove continuously defensive positioning
case_chains.audit_lesson: Use dated mechanism research to form and update stress scenarios; validate the trade bridge separately.
missing: Instrument-level book, hedges and transaction timestamps

case_chains.selection_reason: Original first-person explanation admits a model/override decision and strategy-specific adverse outcome.

predecision_evidence.evidence: Public interview favors diversified investments over cash; available here through a qualified mirror.

case_chains.missing_pretrade_evidence: No authenticated January client memo/risk committee decision found. The March account of tracking virus risk and choosing not to override models is retrospective.
case_chains.position_evidence: Client-note reproduction identifies a long tilt and downside options; Reuters independently describes the note and losses.
case_chains.decision_attribution: Bridgewater team and Dalio first-person collective account; not a single discretionary stock trade.
case_chains.retrospective_reason: The note says uncertainty/absence of edge led the team to retain models rather than override for a novel shock. Tail hedges and liquidity controls did not prevent material loss.
competing_explanations: Hedge design and expiry can matter even when a direction is correct
Partial public return estimates do not establish final year performance
case_chains.audit_lesson: Treat model-domain uncertainty, trade thesis and liquidity survival as separate decisions; log prospective override criteria.
